name: Tianzhou-6
about: Tianzhou-6 (2023-063A), a crewed vehicle (Tianzhou), launched 2023 May 10. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2023 May 10), held fixed
docked to S48274; it stays docked here until its end of mission (GCAT psatcat TDate), when it burns up; the undocking and deorbit burn are folded into that (a fudge of up to a few days)
